resources.string: Monitors screen content and detects possible scam-related activity for your protection.

"Ketu watches for scam patterns in the messages your apps display, and warns you before you act on them.

On-device regex scanning checks visible text for common scam signals such as urgency, financial bait, suspicious links, and credential requests. Only messages matching multiple signals are sent for deeper analysis, most messages never leave your device.

Flagged text is sent through our secure Cloudflare Worker to Google's Gemini AI for a final verdict. The Worker keeps our API key off your device; it is never bundled inside the app.

Confirmed scam alerts are stored locally on your device in a rolling history of up to 100 entries, so you can review past warnings. This history never leaves your device."

"This Privacy Policy describes how Ketu collects, uses, and shares information when you use our service.

1. INFORMATION WE COLLECT
We practice strict data minimization. We do not require or collect account registration details, usernames, email addresses, or phone numbers directly. When our automated regular expression (regex) filters detect a potential scam flag, the contents of that message are processed to verify the threat. This text block may accidentally contain embedded identifiers (like names or contact details) if they were typed into the flagged text.

2. THIRD-PARTY DATA PROCESSING (Google Gemini AI)
To accurately analyze scam patterns, text flagged by our regular expressions is securely transmitted to our Cloudflare Worker, which forwards it to Google's Gemini API service. The Worker exists to keep our API key off your device, it is never bundled inside the app. Flagged message data is processed by Google to improve its machine learning products and may be retained and reviewed by human operators in a de-identified format. Users are advised not to include highly confidential or sensitive personal documents in analyzed text blocks.

3. DATA RETENTION
We do not store or host a permanent database of your message transmissions on our servers. Once a threat analysis is confirmed, the alert timestamp, source app, and the AI's reasoning, is stored locally on your device as part of a rolling history capped at 100 entries. Once that cap is reached, the oldest stored entry is discarded to make room for the newest one.

4. CONTACT US
For any inquiries regarding this data flow, please contact us at calebsarki001@gmail.com"

5. CHANGES TO TERMS
We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. Changes become effective immediately upon being updated within the Application or the project repository. Your continued use of the Application signifies your acceptance of the updated Terms.

6. CONTACT INFORMATION
If you have any questions about these Terms, please contact us at calebsarki001@gmail.com"
